label: run-02
method: Identical to run-01, deliberately. One agent per shard of 25 questions, 18 shards, dispatched from runs/prompt.md verbatim with only the shard path and output path substituted. Each agent was given the question ids and text only, plus the path to R9_1_GX_CLI_Reference/, and was forbidden to read anything under tools/ so the expected facts and reference answers could not leak. Each was told to answer as if to an operator, in roughly 400-800 characters, using the guide's own spelling for identifiers and values.
corpus_note: Corpus and tests are at the same commit for this run, unlike run-01. This run read index/topics.md after the precision fix at 1708f63, which added revocation / signing request / distribution point and removed 'what can' and 'stop'. Run-01 read the pre-fix index.

score_at_run.single: not split at run time, see compare_runs.py

score_note: Scored against the tests at the same commit the answers were produced at, so no test-repair gap separates this number from the run. Compare with run-01 only via compare_runs.py, which rescores every stored run against the working tree.
dispatch_note: All 18 shards dispatched concurrently. No agent reported an unanswerable question. Several reported apparent source-document defects while reading; those are candidates for the list in ../../README.md and were not repaired in the answers.
